Reminders only work reliably when these are set. Items marked Required must be on.
Needed to show the reminder. Both the \"Pill reminders\" and \"Pill alarm\" channels must be on.
Lets the app fire at the exact time.
Lets the app see when you pick up your phone. Without it, only the fallback time triggers dose 1.
Lets the alarm turn the screen on over the lock screen.
Set to \"Don\'t optimise\" so the system doesn\'t stop the app in the background.
Auto-launch, lock in Recents and sleep standby. These can\'t be detected, so you tick them off yourself.

OxygenOS kills background apps aggressively, and if it kills this app the reminders won\'t fire. Do these steps once after installing. Menu names vary slightly between OxygenOS builds; if a path doesn\'t match, use the search box in Settings.
Settings → Apps → Auto launch (or App management → PillReminder → Auto launch) → on. This lets the app start after a reboot.
Open Recents, tap the ⋮ menu (or long-press) on PillReminder → Lock. This stops \"clear all\" from killing it.
Turn it off if present: Battery → More settings → Sleep standby optimisation → off. Also turn off any \"Deep optimisation\" or \"Advanced optimisation\" for the app.
If the alarm doesn\'t vibrate or show while Do Not Disturb is on, go to Settings → Sound & vibration → Do Not Disturb and allow Alarms, or add PillReminder under Apps exceptions.
Verify: run Settings → Test alarm. Then lock the phone and wait for a 1-minute test escalation. The screen should turn on with the alarm.
After an OxygenOS update, re-check these steps and the battery setting, because updates sometimes reset them.
Reminders may not work: a required permission is missing.
